title: Paragon Cleanup Protocol for NGS Preparation
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the desired protocol parameters (e.g., select a 4× cleanup) in the provided fields.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and select your labware files with a .json extension.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload your protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tiprack, and pipette using the OT App; consult the support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” to start the cleanup procedure.
